Cómo organizar la agenda y los recordato: How to organize your calendar and appointment reminders · Alter-Karute
Una agenda desordenada cuesta tiempo y e: A messy calendar costs time and energy. With a few habits you can reduce last-minute cancellations and work with more peace of mind.
Establezca días y horas fijos de atenció: Set fixed days and hours of attendance, with gaps between sessions to rest and prepare for the next one. Clear availability avoids back-and-forth messages.
Envíe un recordatorio uno o dos días ant: Send a reminder one or two days before, with date, time, format and a link if it's virtual.
Pida confirmación sencilla: un clic es m: Ask for simple confirmation: one click is better than a written reply.
Automatizarlos le ahorra mensajes manual: Automating them saves you manual messages and reduces no-shows.
Un enlace público de reservas permite qu: A public booking link lets the client choose a free time without writing to you. You receive the appointment already scheduled and avoid overlaps.
Dígala desde la primera sesión: con cuán: State it from the first session: how much notice to give and what happens if none is given. Putting it in writing in the consent avoids misunderstandings.
Ver sus citas junto a su vida personal e: Seeing your appointments alongside your personal life in a single calendar prevents double bookings. Share only what's necessary with your calendar, never session notes.

que se trata de un acompañamiento de bie: that this is wellbeing support, that it does not diagnose or replace medical care, and that they should not stop treatments prescribed by their doctor.

cómo se guarda la información y en qué c: how information is stored and in which cases it could be shared.
para qué se usan y cómo ejercer sus dere: what they are used for and how to exercise their rights.
Antes de la primera sesión o al comenzar: Before the first session or at the start. If the type of support changes, it's worth updating it. With minors, their representative signs it.
Firmado y con fecha, dentro de la ficha: Signed and dated, inside the client's file.

Cómo llevar la ficha de un consultante e: How to keep a client's file in alternative therapies · Alter-Karute
La ficha de un consultante es su memoria: A client's file is your working memory: it lets you pick up each meeting without starting from zero and support the process with continuity. It doesn't need to be long, but it should be clear and consistent.
1. Qué incluir en la primera sesión: 1. What to include in the first session
nombre, documento, edad, contacto y pers: name, ID, age, contact and support person if applicable.
en palabras del propio consultante, sin: in the client's own words, without interpreting them.
situación de vida, hábitos, procesos pre: life situation, habits, previous processes and what they expect from the support.
modalidad, frecuencia, tarifa y consenti: format, frequency, fee and signed consent.
Una nota breve y ordenada basta. Una est: A brief, orderly note is enough. A simple structure:
technique, topic or practice of the session.
Escriba pronto, mientras la sesión está: Write soon, while the session is fresh, and use descriptive language instead of labels or judgments.
Una sola ficha por consultante, con fech: One file per client, with a date on each entry.
Los documentos firmados no se modifican:: Signed documents are not modified: if something changes, a clarifying note with its date is added.
Guarde adjuntos (consentimientos, inform: Keep attachments (consents, reports) within the same file.
La ficha contiene información personal d: The file contains sensitive personal information. Use strong passwords, don't share your account and avoid keeping files in loose notebooks or chats. A platform with encrypted data and access only for you reduces risks.
Cada cierto tiempo relea las notas del c: Every so often reread the client's notes: you'll see what has changed, what is still pending and when it makes sense to close or redefine the process.

Cómo hacer seguimiento del proceso de un: How to follow a client's process and close it with calm · Alter-Karute
Un buen acompañamiento tiene principio,: Good support has a beginning, a development and a closing. Following up helps you know whether the process is still useful and to end it with no loose ends.
1. Acuerde metas desde el inicio: 1. Agree on goals from the start
Pregunte qué espera el consultante y esc: Ask what the client expects and write it in their own words. Those goals will be the compass for each review.
Cada cierto número de sesiones, repase l: Every certain number of sessions, go over the goals with the client.
Use preguntas abiertas: ¿qué ha cambiado: Use open questions: what has changed? what is still difficult?
Si usa escalas o cuestionarios sencillos: If you use simple scales or questionnaires, apply them the same way every time so you can compare.
Anote lo que el consultante percibe, no: Note what the client perceives, not just what you observe.
Puede ser momento de cerrar cuando se al: It may be time to close when the goals were reached, the client already has their own tools, or the process stalled and another form of support would serve them better. Also when the client decides so.
Dedique una sesión a mirar el recorrido: Devote a session to looking at the journey and what was learned.
Deje por escrito recomendaciones y, si c: Leave recommendations in writing and, if appropriate, suggest consulting other professionals.
Informe que la puerta sigue abierta para: Let them know the door remains open to return.
Registre el cierre en la ficha con fecha: Record the closing in the file with the date.
Una breve encuesta de satisfacción al te: A brief satisfaction survey at the end gives you valuable information to improve your practice.
